bagPolicy.summary: The Cedar Cultural Center hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Metered street parking is available but fills up fast, and meters on Cedar Avenue are enforced until 10pm. For ramp parking, use the University of Minnesota 19th Avenue Ramp, about a third of a block east of The Cedar.
parking.quote: Metered street parking is available, but tends to fill up fast.

rideshare.summary: There's a loading zone and drop-off spot directly in front of The Cedar's front doors. There's no curb cut in front of the venue; the closest one is at the crosswalk about 200 feet south of the front doors.
rideshare.quote: Directly in front of The Cedar's front doors, there is a loading zone/drop off spot.

concessions.summary: The Cedar serves beer, wine, and NA and THC beverages, plus chips and cookies, with vegan and gluten-free options.
concessions.quote: The Cedar serves a variety of beer, wine, and NA & THC beverages, as well as chips and cookies.

accessibility.summary: The Cedar always sets aside a section of seats and spaces for guests who need seating accommodations, and it has an all-gender, ADA-accessible restroom near the main entrance. Service animals as defined by the ADA are welcome. To arrange support, call the box office at 612-338-2674 or email tickets@thecedar.org.
accessibility.quote: The Cedar always sets aside a section of seats and spaces for patrons who require special seating accommodations.

reEntry.summary: The Cedar Cultural Center hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Online ticket sales end at 6:30pm, after which tickets may be available at the door if the show isn't sold out. Events are all ages unless the event page says otherwise, and children 5 and up need a ticket. Students with a current school ID can get a discounted ticket at the door for Cedar-presented shows.
ticketPickup.quote: People of all ages are welcome to all events unless noted otherwise on individual events' pages.

gates.summary: Door times are listed on each event's page and are usually 30 minutes to an hour before showtime.
gates.quote: Door times are listed on each event's page, and are 30 minutes-1 hour prior to showtime.
